utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is case IT-09-92-T, the Prosecutor versus Ratko Mladic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. The Chamber was informed that the Prosecution would like to raise one preliminary matter before we go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President. Good morning everyone, Your Honours. Yes, regarding the tactical intercepts, we have sorted that out. We've had to divide it into two different numbers. And the one for the Prosecution, it was 65 ter 23255A, has been uploaded and assigned P01496 which is currently MFI'd. And that needs to go on itself because I guess it's already been done, but we have for the pages that Mr. Stojanovic wanted, which cover the period of 15 July, as P014 -- sorry, as 65 ter 23255B. And I believe that's what the Defence would like to admit.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: But no provisional number was assigned to that series?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then, Mr. Stojanovic, it seems that from your nodding, you apparently are agreeing. Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I just wanted to thank the Prosecution for their logistical support.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Then, Madam Registrar, 65 ter 23255A for which P1496 was provisionally reserved now receives that number and is admitted into evidence. No need to have it under seal. Then for 65 ter 23255B, a number should be assigned but I take it that it would then be a Defence number. Madam Registrar, that would be?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: That will be number D296, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: D296 is admitted into evidence. If there is no other matter, we move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Could I have the unprofessional assistance of all those who are able to push a button?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. Order of witnesses, Mr. McCloskey or Mr. Groome, who will be first next week?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. We'll continue to hear his testimony. Then we adjourn for the day and we will resume on Monday, the 3rd of June, 2013, Courtroom I, at 9.30 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 3rd day of June, 2013, at 9.30 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.19 p.m.,
